evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce FigmaEval, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on professional UI design tasks, comprising 84 tasks and 783 screens derived from real-world Figma design files.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent advances in AI agents have enabled autonomous UI design using professional tools such as Figma, yet evaluating their design capabilities remains challenging due to the open-ended nature of design tasks and the absence of unique ground truths.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: To assess design quality beyond reference similarity, we develop 22 expert-grounded evaluation rubrics across six dimensions and introduce a human evaluation arena where professional designers compare agent-generated designs through blinded pairwise judgments.
